output_combination: mean head scalar logits, no output activation
self_loops: include one self entry in each masked row-softmax
selection: each variant independently selects earliest epoch with minimum validation graph-mean cross entropy; no architecture/head/seed search
baselines: reuse published validation-selected no_graph and full-neighbor GraphSAGE predictions after new model selection; do not retrain
test_status: public teaching benchmark reused, not a new blind test
